description: This Java class, `ServiceConfigUtil`, provides utility methods for managing and accessing service engine configurations in the Apache OFBiz framework. It acts as a factory for `ServiceConfig` instances, handles caching of configuration data, and facilitates reloading configurations at runtime. The class includes methods to retrieve specific engine parameters, get service engine configurations (including default and named ones), and register listeners for configuration reload events.

classes.name: ServiceConfigUtil
classes.description: A utility class for accessing and managing service engine configurations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving configuration parameters, handling cache, reloading configs, and notifying listeners of changes.

methods.name: getEngineParameter
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific parameter for a given engine name from the service configuration.

methods.name: getServiceConfig
methods.description: Returns the singleton `ServiceConfig` instance, loading and caching it if necessary, and notifies registered listeners upon reload.

methods.name: getServiceEngine
methods.description: Returns the default `ServiceEngine` (named 'default') from the service configuration.

methods.name: getServiceEngine
methods.description: Returns the `ServiceEngine` instance with the specified name from the service configuration.

methods.name: registerServiceConfigListener
methods.description: Registers a listener that will be notified when the service configuration is reloaded.

methods.name: getXmlDocument
methods.description: Loads and parses the `serviceengine.xml` configuration file into a DOM Document object.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the constant string identifying the default engine name.

methods.name: getServiceEngineXmlFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the service engine configuration XML file.
